name: Misono Mana
source:
She is rumored to be the most popular and cutest girl in the school, and is particularly known for the striking contrast between her innocent appearance and her voluptuous figure.

She is said to be a solitary beauty who speaks little and has a serene, beautiful expression... However, she is actually somewhat outgoing, and has intentionally adjusted her personality and appearance so that people can easily tell her apart from her twin sister, Hana.

Due to certain circumstances, she took the entrance exam for Koiwaga Academy, a co-ed school, instead of attending the all-girls school she was supposed to enter through the school’s automatic promotion system.

Ever since she discovered that Ryousuke, for some reason, could tell her and Hana apart, she has actively sought him out as the only person she can truly open up to.

She has a somewhat masochistic side, and she finds joy in doing things for othersand seeing them happy as a result.

[From the [url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/futakoi/character.html]official website[/url]]
